scope: One bounded local CUDA adapter trial from ten authored two-file training fixtures. No general coding or autonomous learning claim.

hardware.environment: Dedicated LocalCodingAssistant WSL 2 Ubuntu 24.04.5 on the PC

memory_scope: PyTorch allocator peaks, not total physical GPU use. Reservation reached approximately card capacity; one Windows GPU sample during training showed 15,962 MiB used including desktop. No claim of comfortable headroom.

direct_development.scope: Direct one-pass JSON repairs, not an RLM benchmark. Same NF4 base, prompt, greedy decoding and 1024-token cap; adapter disabled for baseline. Dev fixtures only; holdout unused.

rlm_development.scope: Same RLM harness, unchanged prompt, NF4 base, greedy decoding, and shared task budgets; adapter disabled for baseline. Development only; holdout unused.

decision: Keep as a training-path experiment. Both base and adapter scored 0/5 in each development harness. Fewer failed calls or lower training loss do not justify promotion.
observations: The adapter returned a parseable patch for all five RLM development tasks, but every patch failed functional checks.
The RLM base produced no accepted patch within the chosen budgets.
Neither model used recursive child calls.
The adapter frequently echoed repository input in direct JSON repairs.
These tiny authored fixtures and 18 fitting training rows cannot establish general coding quality.
Holdout tasks were not used in this training or evaluation round.
fixes: Render and verify chat-template text before separately tokenizing the generation prefix and continuation; this prevents BPE merging across the mask boundary.
Install gcc and Python development headers for Triton before local CUDA training.
Restore Mac access through an SSH loopback connection on port 18080; PC chat stays on port 8080.
checks: Regression check reproduced the prompt-boundary failure before the fix and passed afterward.
Real Qwen tokenizer verified complete assistant-only examples.
CUDA tensor and NF4 quantization checks passed on RTX 5070 Ti.
Training exporter and launcher self-checks passed.
Saved adapter loaded for direct and matched RLM development comparisons.
